title: Overlapping bearer-centres without an exclusive owner
domain: One fixed P/I/K/event/target binding with two simultaneous live anchor-route-consumer triples and a named downstream consumer
conditional_conclusion: Multiple local bearer-centred relations are coherent without an owner selector. A claim that one named target is jointly centred additionally requires non-exclusive actual participation from both routes.
open_bridge: B_pc^family interprets the transported family as multiple practical coordinates inside experience; phenomenal target, measurement, H_cf and subject count remain open.
proof_role: Complete classification of all 16 Boolean mergers after two one-bit XOR BCR witnesses yields two projections and two symmetric mergers at matched normal output.
